versions.changelog:
Initial release of mflux: local image generation on Apple Silicon with Apache 2.0 and high-quality models.

- Generate images locally using Apple MLX on Mac (M1 or later), no cloud/API keys needed
- Supports fast FLUX.2-klein-4B (default, Apache 2.0), FLUX.2-klein-9B, Z-Image-Turbo, and more
- Optional low-RAM mode via quantization (8-bit, 4-bit)
- Python API and CLI for image, img2img, LoRA, and editing workflows
- Automatic model downloading/caching, with RAM/speed/quality comparison tables for optimal use
